cp18:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi mahesakkho mah' iddhiko Dhammo nāma mahāyakkho sabbalokānukampako, || ||
cp18:2.1: Dasakusalakammapathe samādapento mahājanaṃ carāmi gāmanigamaṃ samitto saparijjano. || ||
cp18:3.1: Papo kadariyo yakkho dīpento dasapāpake so p' ettha mahiyā carati samitto saparijjano. || ||
cp18:4.1: Dhammavādī Adhammo ca ubho paccanikā mayaṃ dhure dhuraṃ ghaṭṭayantā samimhā paṭipathe ubho || ||
cp18:5.1: Kalaho vattatī bhesmā kalyāṇapāpakassa ca maggā okkamanatthāya mahāyuddho upaṭṭhito. || ||
cp18:6.1: Yadi' haṃ tassa pakuppeyyaṃ yadi bhinde tapoguṇaṃ saha parijanaṃ tassa rajabhūtaṃ kareyya' haṃ. || ||
cp18:7.1: Api cāhaṃ sīlarakkhāya nibbāpetvāna mānasaṃ saha janen' okkamitvā pathaṃ pāpassa' dās' ahaṃ. || ||
cp18:8.1: Saha pathato okkante katvā cittassa nibbutiṃ vivaraṃ adāsi paṭhavī pāpayakkhassa tāvade 'ti. || ||
